sourceLineage.origin: STMicroelectronics official investor relations Q2 2026 key facts

observations: ST reports Q2 2026 revenue of $3.49B, up 26% year over year, with 34.8% gross margin.
Q1 2026 revenue was $3.10B and GAAP operating income $70M; Q2 midpoint outlook had been $3.45B revenue.
ST's restructuring program focuses investment on 300mm silicon, 200mm silicon carbide and R&D while resizing the global cost base; up to 2,800 voluntary departures were contemplated over three years.
risks: high planned capex during cyclical semiconductor conditions
contradictions: Strong Q2 revenue growth coexists with a continuing footprint/cost-base restructuring program, indicating recovery does not eliminate structural efficiency pressure.
unknowns: segment-level Q2 demand quality and inventory normalization

recommendation.reason: Fresh primary revenue/margin and restructuring evidence supports underwriting while preserving cyclicality and execution uncertainty.
